open_questions: The 62 entries at 0x08a70000..0x08a700f4 are Ghidra EXTERNAL import placeholders (libc/libstdc++ names), not code in the image; the merge lane should record them as imports and not as translated functions.

PB_InitHandlers stores code addresses LAB_0813c43a, LAB_0813c524, LAB_0813c582 and LAB_0813c5a8, which are outside this chunk function list; they are referenced as fn_0813c43a and friends and need function boundaries from the chunk that owns those bytes.

The red-black tree accessors (fn_0813ad4a root, fn_0813add2 leftmost, fn_0813ade0 rightmost, fn_0813af60 and fn_0813b7e8 child slots, fn_0813af94 comparator) are inferred from use; the owning chunks must confirm which link each one returns before the tree code is treated as a std::map equivalent.
Crt_RunCtors return value is an uninitialized stack local in the binary (translated as 0); confirm the caller ignores it.

Behaviour kept as found: PB_HandleCommand ConCapBufLen stores argument pointer bits into the int limit, and PB_CopyFile pairs new[] with operator delete. Both are observable in the binary and should be preserved in the native port unless the owner decides otherwise.
